reason: The cited evidence confirms HfMoTaTiZr's high-temperature strength (E4) and that Hf-Mo-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys form a BCC solid solution (E3), but it provides no support for the key premises that Al substitution reduces density while maintaining properties or that the high-entropy effect ensures this outcome.
premises: Substituting heavy elements with lighter ones reduces alloy density
High-entropy effect promotes simple solid solution formation
Simple solid solution maintains mechanical properties at high temperature
